about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Ted Lieu

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TYLER'S LAW
statements.title: TYLER'S LAW
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 2004, Tyler's Law.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support this bill so we can honor Tyler and prevent fentanyl deaths in the future.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RELEASE THE EPSTEIN FILES
statements.title: RELEASE THE EPSTEIN FILES
sentences: Mr. Speaker, in February of this year, Attorney General Pam Bondi went on national TV and told the American people that Jeffrey Epstein's client list was ``sitting on my desk right now.'' Why won't she release that client list?
Shortly after my speech, Congress is going to shut down until September because House Republicans want to avoid voting on releasing the Epstein files.
The Wall Street Journal just confirmed that in May of this year the Department of Justice told Donald Trump to his face that he is in the unreleased Epstein files.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I ask unanimous consent to amend the rule to make in order the amendment at the desk that protects against any cuts to Medicaid and SNAP.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AMERICA IN DECLINE UNDER REPUBLICAN ECONOMIC POLICIES
statements.title: AMERICA IN DECLINE UNDER REPUBLICAN ECONOMIC POLICIES
sentences: They want to pass the big, ugly bill that is going to cut off healthcare for over 16 million Americans, all in service of massive tax breaks to billionaires.
Trump and Republicans should be working for the American people, not for billionaires. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NO CONDITIONS ON AID
statements.title: NO CONDITIONS ON AID
sentences: I am asking Republican Members of Congress to please stop using the pain and suffering of disaster victims for their own political purposes.
